name: ynf-sandbox
description: The sandbox's own harness: lint, docs and CI-fix focuses with deterministic sensors

tidy.prompt: Fix the lint findings described in the task, in the package the task names and nowhere else. Fix the cause; do not silence a finding with a nolint comment or by discarding an error with `_ =`. Do not edit linter configuration, sensor scripts or CI workflows. Stop when the change is ready: do not commit, push or open pull requests, because whatever ran you does that.

docs.prompt: Make the documentation match the code, or the authoritative source the task names. Change documentation, not behaviour. Do not edit sensor scripts or CI workflows. Stop when the change is ready: do not commit, push or open pull requests.

fix-ci.prompt: A pull request's CI is failing; the task quotes the failing check. Make the smallest change that makes that check pass without changing what the pull request is trying to do. Do not edit linter configuration, sensor scripts or CI workflows. Stop when the change is ready: do not commit, push or open pull requests.
